evidence_gaps: Historical calls are block-end state, not intra-transaction state snapshots.
Only selected funding, donation, borrow and bridge receipts were obtained; full swaps, liquidations, all liabilities and final profit were not independently reconstructed.
Source verification is reported by Sourcify; no local compilation or fork replay was run.
source_vs_history: Provider source verification, historical deployment binding, state reads and transaction observations are separate; see case document and batch evidence.
